rationale: Revised plan addresses three feedback findings on missing grouping dimensions. Prior plan grouped only by the composite provider_specialty+network_status. Per reflection guidance, group_by now includes all three available options: provider_specialty alone, network_status alone, and their composite. This produces the missing network_status groups and missing provider_specialty groups identified in failed checks. min_group_size raised from 0 to 30 to enable correct small-group flagging per feedback remediation guidance (small-group flag at 30 claims). All other parameters and components unchanged; retrieved skill on denial-rate denominator selection remains applied.
changes_summary: In group_comparison: (1) expanded group_by from single composite ['provider_specialty+network_status'] to three entries ['provider_specialty', 'network_status', 'provider_specialty+network_status'] to generate the missing network_status-only and provider_specialty-only groups; (2) raised min_group_size from 0 to 30 to correctly flag small groups per feedback criteria.
